query:
SELECT js.*, j.* 
FROM journalSources js 
LEFT JOIN journals j ON js.journalId = j.id 
WHERE js.sourceType = 'expense' 
AND js.sourceId IN (SELECT id FROM expenses WHERE docNumber = '07202603437463826')
ORDER BY js.id DESC
